name: Chikan wa Hanzai!
source:
Main character is a student council president and the most popular boy at school with his personal fan-club. But his true identity is molester and transvestite. Whenever he sees a cute proud girl, he can go any lengths to crush her will and enslave her. He wears girl clothes and approaches his prey under disguise of cute girl Akira.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是学生会主席，也是学校最受欢迎的男孩，拥有自己的粉丝俱乐部。但他的真实身份是性骚扰者和易装癖者。每当他看到一个可爱又骄傲的女孩，他就会不择手段地摧毁她的意志，奴役她。他穿着女孩的衣服，伪装成可爱的女孩阿基拉接近他的猎物。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
